  .btn-icon { flex-shrink: 1; }

This is a simple patch.  Your task is to do more work (write more
CSS, write more tests, write more explanations).  The patch is done
in the form of a small script that you can load in an editor such as
Repl.it (the editor is a small web app on GitHub, which is a
good way to get started with web development).  It will be run by
the script, which is a program written in JavaScript and runs in the
browser.  The script does not do any editing of the existing CSS.

Write a script that runs the patch and writes out the new CSS.  The
script will be run by a command line (terminal) program.  It does
not need to be interactive.  It should be run with the command:

patch-me.css

The script will be written in JavaScript and run in a web browser.  The
web browser will not be able to see the HTML and CSS files that the
script runs in.  Instead, the web browser will see the script.  The
